block_instructions: Never run git commit, git commit --amend, git push, git push -u, or gh pr create unless the user explicitly asks for that exact action in the current message.
Never run destructive git commands (git reset --hard, git push --force, git rebase) unless the user explicitly requests them.
Do not stage or commit on the user's behalf as a follow-up to finishing code changes. Commits, pushes, and pull requests are manual-only.
